title: Further Than Further
body:
🌫️ Further Than Further (FTF)

Further Than Further (FTF) is a lightweight nostalgia modpack that recreates the classic Minecraft Beta atmosphere — the foggy horizons, moody lighting, and old-school UI — inside the modern Minecraft 1.21 engine.

It’s not just about going back — it’s about going further. FTF captures the feeling of old Minecraft while keeping all the smoothness, stability, and new features of the latest version.


✨ Features That Bring Back the Feeling

(Shaderpacks not included - DO NOT update the YACL Mod!)
- [From The Fog](https://modrinth.com/datapack/from-the-fog)
- [Nostalgic Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/nostalgic-tweaks)
- [Old Minecraft Musics](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/old-minecraft-musics)
- [Farlands Reborn](https://modrinth.com/mod/farlands-reborn)



🧭 Why Play FTF?

Feels like 2011 Minecraft, but plays like 2025 Minecraft
Keeps your FPS high and your world simple
Perfect for relaxed survival, creative nostalgia, or old-school adventures
Fully compatible with client and server setups


💾 Compatibility

- Minecraft: 1.21.x
- Mod Loader: Fabric
- Type: Lightweight / Vanilla+
- License: CC0-1.0
